text:
Lina Park: Alert from image-scan: found ~/.vault-token baked into partner container image. Token grant window overlaps last 48h. Marking P0.
Ethan Moore: got it. Which image and tag? Any public pulls?
Lina Park: gcr.io/partners/ingest-service:20260321. Access logs show only internal pulls, but we’ll treat as exposed.
Ruth Chen: scope looks bad: token had policy granting secret/data/staging/* and transit/rewrap. We should assume they could rewrap or read secrets.
Lina Park: immediate actions: (A) revoke token and any associated SA keys, (B) snapshot affected ciphertexts, (C) rewrap ciphertexts to new transit key version, (D) rotate implicated secrets, (E) tighten RBAC for partner roles.
ops-bot: Revocation job started: `vault token revoke <redacted>` -> queued.
vault-bot: Audit export initiated to BigQuery: `bq://security_audit.vault_leak_317001`
Ethan Moore: Marco from infra — please create a new KMS key version for transit and do not rotate the auto-unseal key. We should avoid rekeying unseal unless necessary.
Ruth Chen: agree. We'll only rotate transit key version and rewrap. Lina, please compile list of secret paths accessed by the token.
Lina Park: pulled from audit: secret/data/staging/db/partner-credentials, secret/data/shared/ingest-api-key, secret/data/staging/redis/partner. Exporting list to gs://redwood-sec-evidence/317001/paths.txt
Ethan Moore: snapshotting ciphertexts now to same bucket before any rewrap.
ops-bot: snapshots uploaded.
Ruth Chen: RBAC change: creating tighter partner policy that removes transit/rewrap and limits read to secret/data/staging/db/partner-credentials only. Draft PR created: infra/PR-4521.
Lina Park: partner notified and asked to stop any promotion of that image. Also asked for proof of secure storage on their side.
Ethan Moore: can we schedule a canary rewrap + secret rotate at 03:00 UTC? Minimal traffic window. Canary two instances, then full.
Ruth Chen: yes. Rewrap script prepared: `vault write transit/rewrap ciphertext=@ciphertext key_name=transit-v2` — KMS will use new key version. We'll record all request IDs.
vault-bot: rewrap canary started at 03:00 UTC.
ops-bot: revoke completed at 02:58 UTC. Old token invalid.
Ethan Moore: canary rewrap completed at 03:05 UTC for two secrets. No errors.
Lina Park: rotated staging DB user password canary at 03:10 UTC. Application smoke test passed for canary pods.
Ruth Chen: rolling full rotate now. Also invalidating partner's GCP service-account keys used to push images.
ops-bot: service-account key disable action executed.
system: Audit logs show a handful of reads during token's active window; nothing after revocation. Exported evidence and checksums uploaded to gs://redwood-sec-evidence/317001/manifest.sha256.gpg
Lina Park: compliance: we need a signed timeline, SHA256 of offending image, and who performed revocation/rotations. Ruth, can you assemble?
Ruth Chen: assembling signed bundle and will attach to the incident ticket.
Ethan Moore: postmortem TODOs: 1) CI image scanner rule to fail builds containing dotfiles with tokens, 2) require vault-agent or Kubernetes CSI provider for secrets mounted by apps, 3) deny transit write to third-party partner policies by default, 4) periodic audit job to flag broad tokens. I'll own the alerts.
Lina Park: good. Also add a gating rule: no long-lived tokens in CI; rotate on each build and use short TTLs.
ops-bot: alert created: "vault-token-in-image" -> pages sec-oncall.
Ruth Chen: partner agreed to rotate their creds and provide a remediation plan within 24h.
Ethan Moore: closing loop: evidence preserved, tokens revoked, secrets rewrapped and rotated, RBAC tightened. Leaving postmortem open for follow-ups.
Lina Park: thanks team — will link postmortem when ready and keep the evidence bucket read-only.
